name: Fluidomat Ltd
tagline: High-quality fluid-couplings microcap (ROCE ~36%, debt-free, dividends) hitting a genuine deceleration — capex + exports are catalysts, but the air pocket isn't resolved
business_overview: Fluidomat manufactures fixed-speed and variable-speed fluid couplings for industrial and automotive drives. Long-established, well-covered microcap with a strong compounding history. ValuePickr thread (67 posts) read to July 2026.
fundamentals_table: ~38.5% 5-yr profit CAGR historically — but TTM profit growth turned negative (~-10%) with a working-capital blow-out (WC days ~239 to ~411; debtor days ~118 to ~149)
fundamentals_narrative: An excellent multi-year record (ROCE ~36%, ROE ~28%, debt-free, dividend-paying, ~38% 5-yr profit CAGR) has run into a real deceleration: TTM profit down ~10%, a sharp working-capital deterioration (WC days ~239 to ~411) and rising debtor days. Forward positives from the thread: a ~Rs 35 Cr capex plan funded from internal accruals (per a company PPT, July 2026) and a new Saudi Arabia distributor (Nov 2025). The working-capital issue was not explained/resolved in the posts read.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. 52-week range Rs 550-1,064 — the stock has had a large multi-year run and trades in the upper half of the band; legacy note put P/E ~22x.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 67 posts (first-time read), spanning ~2013 to July 2026. Long-term community conviction is high (a widely-praised 'pedigree to execution' compounding story). Recent posts (2025-26) are lower-volume and mixed: a benign reclassification of ~Rs 25 Cr FDs to 'loans & advances,' a new Saudi distributor, and a ~Rs 35 Cr internally-funded capex plan — set against an unexplained working-capital deterioration and questions about a small non-promoter investment.
community_signal: Deven (roster, 'elevated' tier — no conviction floor) flagged (Aug 2025) that Fluidomat is investing ~Rs 2 Cr in S-Ancial Technologies, a non-promoter 'AI tools' entity, apparently with no equity stake — questionable capital allocation. PavanM (non-trusted, 2 loves) dug further and found S-Ancial described as a website-maintenance/multimedia firm, deepening the doubt about the stated 'business expansion via AI' rationale. Net: a mild governance/capital-allocation caution, no BUY call.
bse_notes: ~Rs 35 Cr capex planned from internal accruals (company PPT, July 2026); ~Rs 2 Cr invested in S-Ancial Technologies (non-promoter). Not independently verified beyond forum-linked disclosures.
bull_case: Genuinely high-quality microcap: ROCE ~36%, ROE ~28%, debt-free, dividend-paying, ~38% 5-yr profit CAGR
Forward capex cycle (~Rs 35 Cr, internally funded) plus export expansion (new Saudi Arabia distributor)
Long, well-regarded ValuePickr track record and management pedigree
bear_case: TTM profit growth turned negative (~-10%) with a sharp working-capital blow-out (WC days ~239 to ~411) that is unexplained in the thread
Debtor days worsening (~118 to ~149) compounds the cash-conversion concern
Trusted-roster user flagged an odd ~Rs 2 Cr investment in a non-promoter entity with no equity stake
Stock has already had a large multi-year run; a 10x in 2-3 years would require the deceleration to reverse sharply and the multiple to expand
verdict_headline: Quality compounder in a genuine air pocket — worth watching for the working-capital issue to resolve, but it does not clear the 10x/2-3yr bar now
verdict_reasoning: The historical quality is real, but TTM profit -10% and a WC-days jump to ~411 are a material, unresolved deceleration, and the VP thread does not show it being fixed
A trusted-roster user flagged an odd small non-promoter investment; with the stock already well off its lows, a 2-3 year 10x is not supported by the current trajectory
Old 108-stock project rated it Tier B ('quality compounder hitting an air pocket'); re-derived under the open-screen thesis it is 'neither' pending evidence the deceleration is temporary
